recipe.visualDefinition: A mid-century soul music album cover featuring a four-man vocal group in a pyramid-style seated formation against a deep, textured blue background, topped with bold, ultra-condensed red typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Bold red title text spanning the full width of the top edge.
Pyramidal arrangement of subjects centered in the lower two-thirds.
High contrast between the bright white shirts and the dark blue backdrop.
Repetitive pattern of paisley vests and trousers unifying the group.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Four men centered, two seated in front and two standing behind, occupying the central and lower portions of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright red title at the top acts as the primary visual weight, balanced by the group's white shirts.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large red title, drop to the white shirts of the group, and settle on the faces of the performers.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark blue negative space surrounds the subjects on the left and right sides.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold and brown tones (paisley patterns and skin tones)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the subjects and the background; high saturation in the red text against the muted blue.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high aspect ratio (tall and narrow)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Hyphen used as a long, thin separator between words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between a massive condensed header and a small, spaced-out sub-header.
graphicDevices: Small logo/catalog number in bottom right corner

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, condensed verticality of the main title.
Provides a similar mid-century grotesque feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a four-man vocal group in 1970s paisley vests and white shirts, seated in a pyramid formation against a dark, textured indigo studio backdrop. Use warm film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ultra-condensed red sans-serif title across the top. Add a small white sans-serif subtitle centered below it with wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the top text ultra-condensed and red?
Is the background a deep, textured blue?
Are the subjects wearing matching paisley patterns?
Is the composition centered and pyramidal?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original group
postGenerationChecks: Check that text does not overlap the subjects' heads.
Ensure the red color is vibrant but feels like printed ink.
Verify the paisley pattern looks like woven fabric, not a digital overlay.
Confirm the pyramid formation is balanced.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a centered group portrait + apply deep blue textured backdrop + add ultra-condensed red header + add wide-tracked white sub-header.
